channel.title: Update Channel
channel.description: The channel for the update. Customers must use only the preview and stable channels - internal is reserved. All new updates will appear in the preview channel before being promoted to the stable channel. A preview channel will get preview and stable updates. A stable channel will get only stable updates. Customers are encouraged to setup a few tills on the preview channels to test drive new updates before being promoted to stable.

maintenanceExclusion.title: Maintenance exclusion
maintenanceExclusion.description: The maintenance exclusion window for the update. The exclusion maintenance period takes precedence over any scheduled maintenance window. Maximum of 30 days allowed. The exlusion window is applied only for stable channel and only for major and minor updates(semantic versioning).

start.title: Exclusion Start (UTC)
start.description: The start date and time of the maintenance exclusion. Specify in the UTC time zone.

duration.title: Exclusion Duration (days)
duration.description: The number of days from the start date for the maintenance exclusion to take precedence. Maximum 30 days.

maintenanceWindow.title: Maintenance window
maintenanceWindow.description: The maintenance window for the update. During this window the update will download and install automatically. To start update the app must be open else it will try to update on the next maintenance window. The maintenance window is applied to preview and stable channels for major, minor and patch updates(see semantic versioning)

days.title: Maintenance Days

additionalFilterExpression.title: Additional filter expression
additionalFilterExpression.description: Extra Kibana Query Language (KQL) clause that is always AND-ed with every quick search. Use it to pre-narrow the catalog (assortment, brand, tags, additional properties, and similar) so typical searches run against a smaller set of items. This is not a default search term and is not shown or editable in the POS. Cashiers still type a query as usual. Leave unset, null, or empty for no extra filtering. Platform constraints still apply (sellable STOCK/SERVICE items, current sales prices, active identifiers, and item status). Invalid KQL makes quick search fail for all users — test the expression in the Complete Item query playground before rollout. KQL syntax: https://www.elastic.co/docs/explore-analyze/query-filter/languages/kql Complete Item fields and nested additional-property syntax: https://developer.hiiretail.com/docs/product-price-and-promotion/concepts/capabilities/querying-for-data/#how-it-works

visibility.title: Keyboard Visibility
visibility.description: Whether to show the on-screen keyboard automatically on input focus, or manually on demand.

enabled.title: Enable Word Suggestions
enabled.description: Enables word suggestions on the on-screen keyboard.

items.title: Suggestion Items
items.description: List of suggestions to show on the on-screen keyboard, e.g. email domains.

id.title: ID
id.description: The label value to be shown in the suggestions.

enabled.title: Enable Age Verification
enabled.description: Enables or disables the age verification feature (EVA integration).

priceVerificationEnabled.title: Enable Price Verification
priceVerificationEnabled.description: Displays a price verification button in PLU and item search, only for countries that do not require a control transaction for that.

customerDisplay.title: Customer display
customerDisplay.description: Customer-facing display attached to a POS workstation.

zoomFactor.title: Zoom Factor
zoomFactor.description: The zoom factor for the CFD application. Intended range is 0.6-2.0 in 0.1 steps (not currently enforced by the data schema).

autoStart.title: CFD: Auto-Start Display
autoStart.description: Enables auto-start of the customer facing display.

welcomeMessage.title: Welcome Message
welcomeMessage.description: Welcome message to display on the customer facing display.

showLoyaltyCard.title: CFD: Show Loyalty Card
showLoyaltyCard.description: Defines whether to show the loyalty card on the CFD.
